statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness suggestive of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9, I47.1)
A 30-day mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial is because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
